threats.title: Ghost aircraft injection via 1090ES spoofing
threats.mechanism: Adversary broadcasts fabricated 1090ES signals from the ground, generating false observables that the system tracks as a real aircraft.

threats.title: GNSS spoofing to induce satellite clock drift
threats.mechanism: Attacker targets the satellite's GNSS receiver with spoofed signals, gradually skewing the onboard clock and biasing all subsequent TOA measurements.

threats.title: RF jamming of payload phased-array antennas
threats.mechanism: High-power continuous wave or noise jamming at 1090 MHz blinds the satellite payload over a specific geographic region.

threats.title: Payload processor DoS via malformed messages
threats.mechanism: Transmitting non-standard or malformed 1090ES frames that trigger buffer overflows or resource exhaustion in the payload extraction firmware.

threats.title: Telecommand spoofing leading to satellite takeover
threats.mechanism: Adversary compromises telecommand cryptographic keys and transmits unauthorized commands to disable the payload or alter satellite orbit.

threats.title: Ground station downlink RF jamming
threats.mechanism: Jamming the L-band/S-band/X-band frequencies at the ground station prevents the reception of observable reports from the constellation.

threats.title: In-transit tampering of observable reports
threats.mechanism: Due to lack of message authentication (W4), an adversary on the ground network alters TOA/FOA values in observable reports.

threats.title: Inter-satellite link jamming and disruption
threats.mechanism: Directional RF or optical interference targeting inter-satellite links prevents report relay, causing observation data loss.

threats.title: PTP delay asymmetry injection over ISL
threats.mechanism: Adversary manipulates routing or introduces directional delays in ISL PTP traffic, skewing the synchronized time between satellites.

threats.title: Ground backhaul DDoS
threats.mechanism: Distributed denial of service targeting the ground segment's WAN backhaul prevents observable reports from reaching the Central Processing Station.

threats.title: Replay of outdated firmware packages
threats.mechanism: Adversary captures and replays an older, vulnerable but authentically signed firmware package to downgrade the satellite flight software.

threats.title: Measurement association confusion via saturation
threats.mechanism: Flooding the system with tightly clustered, synchronized emissions that cause the association module to group measurements incorrectly.

threats.title: Ephemeris database poisoning
threats.mechanism: Network intruder alters satellite orbit/velocity data in the L3 database, fundamentally corrupting the TDOA/FDOA solver calculations.

threats.title: Algorithmic complexity DoS on tracker
threats.mechanism: Crafted edge-case measurement series force the EKF/IMM tracker into worst-case computational paths, exhausting CPS CPU resources.

threats.title: Integrity monitor evasion during WEAK passes
threats.mechanism: Adversary exploiting W3 injects a bias exactly within the stealth window during poor HDOP conditions to displace aircraft invisibly.

threats.title: Synchronized E-MLAT/ADS-B spoofing
threats.mechanism: Attacker simultaneously spoofs the raw RF TOA/FOA and the ADS-B payload content, passing the cross-check with a fabricated location.

threats.title: ASTERIX report interception and suppression
threats.mechanism: Compromise of the gateway allows an attacker to drop specific CAT020/021 reports before they reach the ATM data feed.

threats.title: CPS virtualization escape
threats.mechanism: Attacker leverages a vulnerability in the CPS hypervisor to gain root access to the hosting platform and manipulate all modules.

threats.title: Synchronization policy downgrade
threats.mechanism: Insider or intruder alters the PTP policy thresholds, forcing the system to accept degraded timing tolerances without raising flags.

threats.title: Orbit determination feed spoofing
threats.mechanism: Spoofing the external ground tracking sensors that feed the L4 orbit determination system, causing inaccurate ephemeris generation.

threats.title: Telecommand key exfiltration
threats.mechanism: Intrusion into the L4 key management system to steal symmetric keys used for signing telecommands to the constellation.

threats.title: Supply chain poisoning of firmware baseline
threats.mechanism: Compromising a supplier to introduce backdoored payload firmware into the update management system, infecting the constellation.

threats.title: ATM surveillance feed BGP hijacking
threats.mechanism: Hijacking BGP routes to intercept, modify, or blackhole the surveillance data feed between the CPS gateway and ATM systems.

threats.title: ATM controller display saturation
threats.mechanism: Generating thousands of spurious ghost aircraft tracks to visually overwhelm the ATM controller and obscure a real threat.

threats.title: Insider manipulation of integrity thresholds
threats.mechanism: A rogue employee with authorized access deliberately widens the allowable eps_det integrity thresholds in the configuration system.

threats.title: Ransomware on mission-operations network
threats.mechanism: Ransomware encrypts the L4 management network, halting orbit determination, telemetry monitoring, and configuration updates.

threats.title: Eavesdropping on observable reports
threats.mechanism: Intercepting unencrypted observable reports in transit to track the locations of sensitive or non-public state aircraft.

threats.title: Physical tampering of aircraft transponder
threats.mechanism: An insider alters the hardware or software of a specific aircraft's 1090ES transponder to emit false timing characteristics.

threats.title: GNSS multipath exploitation to mask displacement
threats.mechanism: Deliberately reflecting GNSS signals toward the satellite to create minor, pseudo-random clock jitter that obscures targeted time drifts.

threats.title: False positive flooding of integrity monitor
threats.mechanism: Injecting marginal, widely distributed biases designed specifically to constantly trip the integrity monitor, discrediting the system's reliability.

architecture_weaknesses: W4: Lack of L2 observable authentication allows trivial in-transit tampering, completely undermining the complex L1 timing integrity mechanisms.
W3: System processes reports during WEAK passes without degrading trust, guaranteeing a stealth window for intelligent adversaries to exploit.
W1: Accepting covert clock steps as inevitable assumes GNSS/PTP checks cannot be improved cryptographically or via multi-source clock ensembles.
Cross-check relies on ADS-B, which is unauthenticated. Synchronized spoofing of both RF physical layer and ADS-B data renders the check useless.
Single point of failure at Central Processing Station (A3.7). Complete system denial or compromise if hypervisor is breached.
No authenticated out-of-band management network mentioned for satellites; compromise of L2 links severs all command capabilities.
Ephemeris data (A3.2) trust boundary relies only on L4 governance without apparent cryptographic verification during L3 solver execution.
Over-reliance on static integrity thresholds (eps_det) which can be learned and precisely evaded by timing adversaries.
overall: The threat model covers the physical and signal domains well but structurally underestimates IT/network threats. The lack of message authentication on observable reports (W4) and the accepted stealth window during poor HDOP (W3) constitute systemic flaws that render complex L1/L3 integrity mechanisms easily bypassable by a T2/T3 adversary.
